language.description: Lowercase language identifier matching the manifest file name.

advertised.description: True only when the language passes every mandatory capability of docs/language-parity-contract.md.

tier.description: first-class == advertised. Other values describe unadvertised work-in-progress states.

status.description: adapter-ready has contract evidence but no shipped activation path; runtime-integrated is discoverable and lifecycle-owned by chakra serve.

runtime_evidence.description: Required for runtime-integrated: shipped composition and lifecycle evidence paths.

capabilities.description: Map of capability ID (from the parity contract) to its status record.

mechanism.description: How the capability is met: tree-sitter, provider name, chakra-owned equivalent, etc.

evidence.description: Paths or test names proving the capability. Required for pass/equivalent.

conformance_results.description: Path to the shared conformance-suite result file for this language.

corpus_results.description: Path to the public-corpus evaluation record for this language.

docs.description: Path to the language install/runtime/limitations documentation.
